title: Combined Treatment of Persistent Diabetic Macular Edema with Aflibercept and Triamcinolone Acetonide in Pseudophakic Eyes

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) license, Licensee MDPI, Basel, Switzerland)

condition: Persistent (refractory) centre-involving diabetic macular edema in pseudophakic eyes of type 2 diabetics after three previously administered monthly intravitreal aflibercept injections (anatomical/functional non-response assessed one month after the third injection); prospective, observational, interventional, non-randomized, single centre (Kragujevac, Serbia), 24 eyes of 24 patients split equally into two groups

groups.agent: aflibercept 2 mg/0.05 mL intravitreal every 8 weeks (2 months)
groups.description: Group A: continued aflibercept alone on a fixed every-2-months schedule; six aflibercept injections over the 12-month follow-up

groups.agent: aflibercept 2 mg/0.05 mL every 8 weeks plus intravitreal triamcinolone acetonide 10 mg/0.1 mL (triple sedimentation of Kenalog 40 mg/mL, off-label) every 4 months
groups.description: Group A+TA: same aflibercept schedule plus triamcinolone every 4 months (first TA 2-3 weeks after the first study aflibercept injection; three TA injections in total); the experimental combination arm

series.baseline_label: Baseline (Table 1 row CMT(µm), Baseline column, group A)
series.notes: Mean ± dispersion (caption: 'Mean values'; the ± statistic is not labelled SD or SE); table headers print '>1 Month' ... '>12 Months'; nominal times from the Methods ('OCT examination was performed before the treatment started and after 1, 3, 6, 9 and 12 months'); per-visit n not reported (all eyes reported to have received all six injections)

series.baseline_label: Baseline (Table 1 row CMT(µm), Baseline column, group A+TA)
series.notes: Mean ± dispersion (not labelled SD or SE); same timing as the aflibercept series; per-visit n not reported; eyes with an IOP rise received topical dorzolamide-timolol (no thickness values removed or replaced)

exclusions.what: Table 1 SRF, IRCS, DRIL and ORL/ELM/EZ grade rows
exclusions.reason: proportions of graded OCT biomarkers, not thickness

exclusions.what: Figure 2 CMT means and Figure 3 single-eye example
exclusions.reason: figures/single case; the same group means are cited from Table 1
duplicates of Table 1 cells; ranges are not admissible

notes: Time origin: the first aflibercept injection of the reported study period (baseline visit before the study treatment started); eyes had received three monthly aflibercept injections before baseline (prior_treatment previously_treated); some eyes also had prior focal laser or PRP

CMT was 'measured automatically' on Optopol REVO NX 130 SD-OCT (device other); the Methods do not define CMT as the central 1-mm subfield (the 1-mm area is stated for the OCT biomarker grading), so measure central_unspecified

The Results text words some visits as 'after the last injection'; the Methods and the table caption give follow-up controls after 1, 3, 6, 9 and 12 months from the start of treatment, used as nominal times
Statistical comparisons: two-tailed t-test between groups; the article states means; VA, IOP and OCT biomarkers exist but are not extracted
